final_answer: Training neural networks typically requires substantial resources, including high-performance GPUs or TPUs for processing large datasets (ranging from gigabytes to terabytes). Memory, both RAM and VRAM, can become a bottleneck for larger models. Additionally, significant electrical power and cooling infrastructure are constant requirements, contributing to high operational costs. Data preparation and model tuning also consume considerable human and computational effort.
